headline: Senior iOS Engineer
summary: Seasoned iOS engineer with 9 years of experience building high‑performance financial and productivity apps for LatAm fintechs and remote US clients. Expert in Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, and modern iOS architectures, with a proven track record of reducing latency, increasing user engagement, and streamlining release pipelines through automation and rigorous testing.

experience.title: Senior iOS Engineer
highlights: Led migration of legacy UIKit codebase to SwiftUI for the home dashboard, reducing UI rendering latency by 35% and decreasing crash rate from 2.1% to 0.7% across 1.2M monthly active users.

Implemented Combine‑based reactive networking layer that consolidated REST and GraphQL APIs, cutting average network request time from 820ms to 460ms and enabling feature‑flag rollout for three new credit products.
Automated release pipeline with Fastlane and GitHub Actions, increasing bi‑weekly release frequency from 1 to 4 and reducing manual QA effort by ~200 hours per quarter.
Mentored a team of four junior iOS engineers, establishing code‑review standards that raised average pull‑request approval score from 78% to 94% in SonarQube.
Introduced feature toggles via LaunchDarkly to A/B test a new loan simulator, boosting conversion rate by 12% and generating an additional ARS 4.5M in quarterly revenue.

experience.title: iOS Engineer (Contract)
highlights: Developed a SwiftUI‑based offline‑first notes app for GitLab’s internal knowledge base using Core Data and CloudKit sync, achieving 99.9% data integrity and supporting 15k+ daily active employees.
Integrated GraphQL subscriptions via Apollo iOS, reducing real‑time update latency from 1.2s to 180ms and enabling live collaboration features used by eight distributed teams.
Wrote comprehensive XCTest unit and UI tests covering 78% of critical paths, cutting post‑release bugs by 40% in staging environments.
Optimized app bundle size by 22% through asset‑catalog trimming and lazy module loading, improving download times on low‑bandwidth connections.
Collaborated with product and UX teams in biweekly sprints, delivering six feature releases that adhered to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

experience.title: iOS Engineer
highlights: Built the initial version of Ualá’s expense‑tracking module using UIKit and RxSwift, attracting 250k users within the first six months and increasing daily active users by 18%.
Implemented Core Data migration strategy that safely transformed user data schema across three app versions, preserving 100% of historical transaction records for 500k+ users.
Reduced app launch time from 4.8s to 2.2s by launching asynchronous initialization of analytics and networking stacks, improving user retention by 7% in cohort analysis.
Created a Fastlane automation pipeline that automated beta distribution to TestFlight, cutting release turnaround from 3 days to 4 hours.
Participated in cross‑functional squads of six engineers, conducting peer code reviews that maintained an average code coverage of 72% across new features.
